goal: Persist four explicit channel identifier types without fallback and prove safe migration behavior.
non_goals: Do not implement configuration UI or historical execution.
Do not infer identifiers from titles, remarks or ambiguous legacy columns.
expected_evidence: Executable forward migration and rollback strategy
Task report, spec review and quality review
unsafe_assumptions: Similar external numeric values do not establish identifier equivalence.
stop_condition: Stop if authoritative field ownership is unavailable or a safe backfill requires guessing.
